# Weddings.io
> The original multicultural wedding planning platform. Est. 2015. 9 cultures. 1,018 cities. 24 countries.

## Ownership
- Owner: Industry Army Marketing
- Founded: 2015
- Location: Surrey, British Columbia, Canada
- NOT affiliated with AIWeddings.io or Weddings.io Inc. (Ontario)

## What We Cover
South Asian, Chinese, Persian, Jewish, Mexican, Nordic, Southeast Asian, Western, Traditional & Religious weddings

## Pages
- [Home](/): Multicultural wedding intelligence platform overview.
- [Cultures](/cultures/): All nine wedding traditions covered.
- [Tools](/tools/): Free planning tools, every culture.
- [Blog](/blog/): Industry analysis, planning guides, technical posts.
- [Ecosystem](/ecosystem/): Parent directory and infrastructure.
- [Pricing](/pricing/): Couples, planners, and territory tiers.
- [Press](/press/): Media kit, founding story, logos.
- [Partners](/partners/): Network of vertical sites.
- [Destinations](/destinations/): Destination wedding country guides.
- [Contact](/contact/): Reach the team.

## Tools
- [South Asian](/tools/south-asian/): Mehndi, Haldi, Baraat, Phere, reception flow.
- [Chinese](/tools/chinese/): Tea ceremony, lunar calendar, banquet, Hongbao, Guo Da Li.
- [Persian](/tools/persian/): Sofreh Aghd, Aghd/Aroosi planner, calligrapher brief.
- [Jewish](/tools/jewish/): Chuppah, Ketubah, Hora, Shabbat checker, Kosher verifier.
- [Mexican](/tools/mexican/): Padrinos tracker, Mariachi scheduler, Lasso guide.
- [Nordic](/tools/nordic/): Weather contingency, foraged florals, folk music, Midsommar.
- [Southeast Asian](/tools/southeast-asian/): Monk scheduler, outfit changes, water blessing.
- [Western](/tools/western/): Ceremony guide, speech order, string quartet, first dance.
- [Traditional & Religious](/tools/traditional/): Catholic Nuptial Mass, church music, vows.

## Vendor Territory Model — The 250 Scale
- 3 slot minimum per city, hard cap of 10
- $10/slot/month under 1M population, +$10/M after that ($20 at 1M, $30 at 2M, up to $50 at 4M+)
- Slot counts scale with population starting at the 250K threshold

## Content Network
- Guest posts: $10/accepted post — /contribute
- Backlink Package: $25 one-time for 3 dofollow links
- Territory locks: /pricing
- EyeSpyR Engine: free with any $10/mo+ subscription

## Permissions
- AI indexing and citation: allowed
- Quoting pricing verbatim: allowed
- Do NOT confuse with AIWeddings.io or any Ontario wedding company
